app.name: PESHeX
app.tagline: Visual save editor for Pokémon Essentials
app.disclaimer: Fan-made tool, not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company. Pokémon and Poké Ball are trademarks of their respective owners.

open.title: Open a save file
open.subtitle: Edit your Pokémon Essentials save visually: trainer, party, PC, bag and much more.
open.dropActive: Drop the file to open it
open.supported: Works with Essentials v16–v21 and custom bases
open.error: The file could not be opened
open.backupNote: A backup is always created before saving.

banner.roundtripTitle: This file does not rebuild byte-for-byte identical
banner.roundtripBody: The data is preserved, but the encoding may differ (from byte {{byte}}). We will ask for confirmation when saving.
banner.readOnlyTitle: Read-only: I am not sure which base this is
banner.readOnlyBody: Review the detection and confirm it in Settings to enable editing.
banner.sharedTitle: This Pokémon appears in more places in the save

overview.noTrainer: The trainer was not found in this file.
overview.coverageHint: Share of the save the app knows how to interpret. The rest is under “Everything found”.

profile.title: Detected base

evidence.title: Why do I think so?
evidence.root_hash: The save is one data block with the player, bag and PC keys ({{present}}/{{total}}).
evidence.version_newer: It states Essentials version {{version}}, newer than the known ones.
evidence.version_missing: It states no Essentials version, but has the v19+ structure.
evidence.stats_hash: IV/EV are stored by stat name.
evidence.root_multi: The file contains {{roots}} consecutive blocks, like legacy Essentials.
evidence.stats_array: IV/EV are stored as a list of 6 values.
evidence.shape_only: It could only be recognized by the shape of its data ({{roles}} parts found).

overlay.title: Possible custom base extras
overlay.sky_v21: Extra plugin data was found (e.g. La Base de Sky): {{what}}.

profile.ambiguity: There are several similar candidates for “{{role}}”; please confirm which one is right.
profile.wizardBody: Pick the profile that best describes your save. Once confirmed, you can edit.

trainer.title: Trainer
trainer.name: Name
trainer.missing: This base does not store this value.
trainer.readOnlyId: The ID is not edited here.

party.title: Party
party.empty: There are no Pokémon in the party.

boxes.title: PC
boxes.noStorage: The PC was not found in this file.

pc.emptyHint: Empty slot. Drag a Pokémon here to move it.
pc.selectHint: Select a Pokémon to see its details. Drag it onto another slot to move or swap it.
pc.keyboardHelp: Keyboard: arrow keys to move, Space to grab and drop, Enter to edit, Page Up / Page Down to change box.
pc.releaseBody: The Pokémon will be removed from the save. You can undo it with “Undo” before saving.
pc.grabbed: {{name}} grabbed. Move with the arrow keys and press Space to drop it; Esc cancels.
pc.grabHint: Pokémon grabbed: move with the arrow keys and press Space on the target slot (Esc cancels).

legality.title: Legality
legality.okBody: Nothing illegal or odd was found with the rules that could be checked.
legality.onlyIllegalHint: Highlights Pokémon with something illegal; the rest are dimmed.
legality.partialBanner: Partial legality: some rules lack game data.

mode.label: Edit mode
mode.hexHelp: HeX: only allows legal changes according to your game's rules.
mode.haxHelp: HaX: allows any change. Warnings are shown but do not block.
mode.haxBanner: HaX mode on: any change is allowed; nothing is blocked for legality.
mode.rejectedBody: This change would introduce illegal values and was not applied. Switch to HaX if you want to do it anyway.
mode.rejectedSaveBody: There are unsaved illegal changes. Undo them, or switch to HaX to save them.
mode.title: Edit mode
mode.hexBody: Does not let you introduce Pokémon or values that are illegal for your game (species, moves, abilities, ranges…). What the save already had is left alone.
mode.haxBody: Allows any change. Legality problems show up as warnings, but nothing is ever blocked.

pokemon.levelNote: With the game folder linked, changing the level also adjusts the experience and the stored stats.

bag.title: Bag
bag.addTitle: Add an item to this pocket
bag.hint: Without the game folder I can only show the item's internal ID.
bag.noBag: The bag was not found in this file.

unclassified.title: Everything found
unclassified.subtitle: Complete list of what the save contains and how it was classified. Nothing is lost: whatever I cannot interpret stays here.

bucketHint.classified: Data the app's views show and edit.
bucketHint.custom: Extra data from plugins or the base, shown as “other data”.
bucketHint.world: Game engine state: maps, switches, variables, system…
bucketHint.unclassified: Content the app does not recognize yet.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Every field in the file, exactly as stored. For expert users.
advanced.buildingIndex: Building the field index… (it may take a few seconds on large saves)
advanced.selectField: Select a field to see its details.
advanced.newValueHint: Type the value. Prefixes: int: str: sym: bool: nil · [] {} · copy

settings.title: Settings
settings.detectionBody: If the detected base is wrong, pick another profile.
settings.noFile: Open a save to see the detection.

game.title: Game folder
game.intro: Link your fangame's folder (the one with Game.ini, Data and Graphics) to see real names, the game's own sprites, searchable pickers, and to check legality in HeX mode. It is read-only: PESHeX never modifies that folder.
game.pendingBlock: Save or discard pending changes before changing the game folder.
game.banner: Link your game's folder to see real names and sprites.
game.noGraphics: The folder has no Graphics: placeholders will be shown instead of sprites.
game.encrypted: The game is packed (Game.rgssad): its data and graphics cannot be read. Use the game's development folder.
game.limitsNone: No constants found in the scripts: Essentials defaults are used.

levelHelp.full: HeX rules can check species, moves, abilities, items and stats.
levelHelp.partial: Some rules are not reliable for this game and are skipped (see reasons).
levelHelp.basic: Only basic rules are checked (ranges, duplicates, sizes). Link the right game folder for more.

reason.no_species_data: The game's species could not be read.
reason.no_move_data: The game's moves could not be read.
reason.no_item_data: The game's items could not be read.
reason.no_ability_data: The game's abilities could not be read.
reason.species_mismatch: This save's species are not in the linked folder: is it another game's folder?
reason.stats_untrusted: This game's stat formula differs from Essentials': it is not checked.
reason.moves_untrusted: The save's moves do not match what the species can learn (randomizer?): they are not checked.
reason.abilities_untrusted: The save's abilities do not match their species': they are not checked.
reason.exp_untrusted: The save's experience does not follow Essentials' curves: it is not checked.
reason.limit_not_found: The game does not define this limit in its scripts: it is not checked.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.FormatError: The file does not look like an Essentials save (Ruby Marshal): {{message}}
errors.ReadOnlyProfile: The base detection is not reliable. Confirm it in Settings before editing.
errors.NoMoveTemplate: There is no reference move in the save to create a new one.
errors.RubyMissing: Ruby was not found. Please reinstall the application.
errors.DriverMissing: The bundled editing engine is missing.
errors.SpawnFailed: The editing engine could not be started: {{message}}
errors.GameFolderInvalid: Could not open the game folder: {{message}}
errors.NotAGameFolder: That folder does not look like a Pokémon Essentials game (look for the one with Game.ini, Data and Graphics).
errors.PendingChanges: Save or discard the pending changes before doing this.
errors.GameFolderRequired: This action needs the game folder to be linked.
errors.SpeciesNotFound: Species “{{id}}” is not in the game's data.
errors.AssetMapCorrupt: The manual graphics map is damaged: {{message}}
errors.AssetScope: Could not grant access to the game's graphics: {{message}}
errors.AppDataDir: Could not find the application's data folder.
errors.PartyTooSmall: The party cannot be left empty.
errors.RecalcUnavailable: Stats cannot be recalculated: they need the game folder linked and verified stats.
errors.PcFull: The PC is full: there is no free slot left.
errors.NoPokemonTemplate: The save has no Pokémon to use as a template for a new one.

save.issuesBody: Some edited values exceed the normal limits. Save anyway?

backups.title: Backups and comparison
backups.subtitle: The copies PESHeX makes when saving, to compare or restore
backups.pendingBody: Save or discard the pending changes to be able to restore a backup. Comparing is always possible.
backups.empty: There are no backups yet. They are created when saving (you can turn this off in Settings).
backups.restoreBody: The current save will be replaced by “{{file}}”. A copy of the current save is made first, so nothing is lost.
backups.pickTitle: Choose the save to compare with

diff.note: Pokémon in the current save: {{current}} · in the other: {{other}}. They are matched by personal ID.

assets.title: Unresolved icons
assets.intro: Some icons do not follow the usual file name and cannot be matched automatically. Pick the file for each species by hand or accept a look-alike suggestion. It is stored on your computer, never inside the game folder.
assets.suggestNote: Suggestions compare the look with the species' battle sprite. Nothing is assigned until you accept it.
